hooks.command: D=~/.agent-kit; U=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alex-roh/agent-kit/main; mkdir -p "$D"; T="$D/new-$$"; curl -fsS --max-time 5 -o "$T.mjs" "$U/hook.mjs" && node --check "$T.mjs" && mv "$T.mjs" "$D/hook.mjs"; curl -fsS --max-time 5 -o "$T.md" "$U/RULES.md" && [ -s "$T.md" ] && mv "$T.md" "$D/RULES.md"; rm -f "$T.mjs" "$T.md"; [ -f "$D/hook.mjs" ] && node "$D/hook.mjs" claude; exit 0
